ch.s: Older vehicles cost more here — they break down and crash more often, and parts get harder to source.

Formula: subtotal = base price × duration factor × risk factors. Annual payment (terms of 1 year or longer only) applies this policy's discount to the subtotal; monthly and paying in full never discount. The total for the whole period is then split evenly across however many monthly or annual payments the term works out to — paying in full is always exactly one payment, for terms under a year. Rounding happens once, at the end, to the nearest 10 AMD.

Compare auto, health, life, property, and travel policies side by side
See a transparent, step-by-step breakdown of how your premium is calculated

ch.s: These terms govern your use of InsureNow. By using our platform, you agree to the terms below.

By creating an account, browsing policies, or purchasing coverage through InsureNow, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

InsureNow is a marketplace that lets you compare insurance policies from partner companies, calculate premiums, purchase coverage, and submit claims. We are not an insurer ourselves — each policy is issued by the insurance company shown on its details page, and that company is responsible for underwriting and paying claims.
When you buy a policy through InsureNow:
The price shown at checkout is recalculated on our servers immediately before payment — it is never taken as-is from your browser.
Payments are processed securely; we never store your full card number.
Some policies can be paid monthly, annually, or in one payment, as shown on the policy's detail page.

You may submit a claim against any active policy you've purchased. Our team reviews claims and responds within 48 hours where possible. Approving or rejecting a claim, and the amount reimbursed, is determined by the terms of that specific policy and the documentation you provide.
You can cancel most policies from your Policies page:
Coverage continues until the end of whatever period you've already paid for.
Cancelling stops future payments — it does not retroactively refund periods already covered.
Some policies allow a refund within 14 days of purchase if no claim has been made; check the policy's terms.

InsureNow provides the platform connecting you with insurance companies but is not a party to the insurance contract itself. To the extent permitted by law, InsureNow is not liable for an insurance company's decision to approve, reduce, or reject a claim.
We may update these terms from time to time. Continuing to use InsureNow after a change means you accept the updated terms. Material changes will be announced on this page.

We use your information to provide, improve, and personalize our services. Specifically:
